mapper.sql:
select convert('system' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as notice_source, n.notice_id, null as club_id, convert('全站公告' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as club_name, n.notice_title collate utf8mb4_general_ci as notice_title, cast(n.notice_content as char character set utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as notice_content, cast(null as char character set utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as cover_url, n.notice_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as notice_type, n.create_by collate utf8mb4_general_ci as publisher_name, n.create_time as publish_time, (case when r.notice_id is null then '0' else '1' end) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as read_status from sys_notice n left join app_notice_read r on r.user_id = #{userId} and r.notice_source = 'system' and r.notice_id = n.notice_id where n.status = '0'
union all
select convert('club' using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as notice_source, cn.notice_id, cn.club_id, c.club_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as club_name, cn.notice_title collate utf8mb4_general_ci as notice_title, cn.notice_content collate utf8mb4_general_ci as notice_content, cn.cover_url collate utf8mb4_general_ci as cover_url, cn.notice_type collate utf8mb4_general_ci as notice_type, cn.publisher_name collate utf8mb4_general_ci as publisher_name, ifnull(cn.publish_time, cn.create_time) as publish_time, (case when r.notice_id is null then '0' else '1' end) collate utf8mb4_general_ci as read_status from club_notice cn inner join club c on c.club_id = cn.club_id and c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' left join app_notice_read r on r.user_id = #{userId} and r.notice_source = 'club' and r.notice_id = cn.notice_id where cn.status = '1' and cn.del_flag = '0' and exists ( select 1 from club_member cm where cm.club_id = cn.club_id and cm.user_id = #{userId} and cm.status = '0' and cm.del_flag = '0' )
mapper.insert: insert ignore into app_notice_read ( user_id, notice_source, notice_id, read_time, create_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{noticeSource}, #{noticeId}, now(), now() )
insert ignore into app_notice_read ( user_id, notice_source, notice_id, read_time, create_time ) select #{userId}, 'system', n.notice_id, now(), now() from sys_notice n where n.status = '0'

insert ignore into app_notice_read ( user_id, notice_source, notice_id, read_time, create_time ) select #{userId}, 'club', cn.notice_id, now(), now() from club_notice cn inner join club c on c.club_id = cn.club_id and c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' where cn.status = '1' and cn.del_flag = '0' and exists ( select 1 from club_member cm where cm.club_id = cn.club_id and cm.user_id = #{userId} and cm.status = '0' and cm.del_flag = '0' )
